description: List GPU nodes available to rent right now, with price per hour, GPU model, VRAM, CUDA compute capability, and country. Rent by the returned node_id. reserved_for_you: true marks a node its provider keeps for this key's person or organization: such nodes come first and nobody else sees them. Read-only, no cost. For modern LLM work prefer compute_cap >= 8.9 (FP8). spot: true marks a spot node: cheaper (list_price_per_hour is the on-demand price), but its provider can take it back with two minutes' notice, so avoid it for long unattended jobs. restricted_internet: true means the node's own network cannot reach the services in unreachable_services (e.g. GitHub, Hugging Face, PyPI, Docker Hub), so git clone, pip install and model or image downloads fail there; prefer a node where it is false when the job downloads anything (null means not checked yet). ssh: true means create_rental can start it with type 'ssh'. templates lists the apps create_rental can install on that node (e.g. ["comfyui"]); see list_templates.
name: list_gpus
